title: DAMEGE Get Random Structure Loot 受傷獲得隨機結構寶箱
description: If you get injured, you can get a random structure treasure chest!受傷就能獲得隨機結構寶箱！
body:
每当你受到任何伤害，就会随机获得一个结构的战利品箱子，打开即可获取该结构对应的随机奖励物资！

玩法机制

触发条件：受到任何伤害（怪物攻击、摔落、烧伤、溺水、饥饿等皆可）

触发效果：随机从 15 种结构中抽选 1 种，直接获得对应的战利品箱子

触发频率：无冷却时间，每次掉血都会触发

获取方式：箱子直接进入背包（背包满则掉落在脚下）

使用方法：将箱子放置在地面上，右键打开即可获得战利品表生成的随机物品

结构宝箱共 15 种

注意事项


⚠️ 本数据包无冷却时间，战斗、跌落、烧伤等都会频繁掉血触发，建议搭配多人或冒险存档使用，避免在创造模式或单纯刷怪测试时无限刷物品

📦 背包已满时箱子会掉落在脚下，记得留出空间或及时整理背包

🎮 适用版本：Minecraft Java 版 1.21.x（含 1.21.11 及以上）

🔄 如需关闭效果，删除 datapacks 文件夹内对应的 zip 文件后 /reload 即可


常见问题

Q: 为什么我受伤了没有获得箱子？

A: 请确认 /reload 后看到加载成功提示，且数据包文件结构正确（pack.mcmeta 应直接位于 zip 根目录，而非套在一层文件夹内）。


Q: 箱子的名字会显示乱码或 JSON 文本吗？

A: 不会，箱子名称已修复为正常显示（如「沉船宝箱」），不含颜色或多余符号。


Q: 可以同时使用其他数据包吗？

A: 可以，本数据包不会修改原版战利品表，只是额外发放箱子，与其他数据包基本不冲突。


Whenever you take any damage, you will randomly receive a loot chest from a specific structure. Open it to get the random reward items associated with that structure!

Gameplay Mechanics

Trigger Condition: Taking any damage (monster attacks, fall damage, burning, drowning, starvation, etc.).

Trigger Effect: Randomly selects 1 from 15 structures and grants its corresponding loot chest.

Trigger Frequency: No cooldown. Triggers every time you lose health.

Acquisition Method: The chest goes directly into your inventory (drops at your feet if your inventory is full).

Usage: Place the chest on the ground and right-click to open and receive random items generated by the loot table.Total Variety: 15 types of structure chests available.

Important Notes

⚠️ No Cooldown: Regular damage will trigger this frequently. Recommended for multiplayer or adventure maps to prevent infinite item farming during creative mode or mob farm testing.

📦 Inventory Management: Chests drop at your feet when your inventory is full. Remember to clear space or organize your items in time.

🎮 Supported Versions: Minecraft Java Edition 1.21.x (including 1.21.11 and above).

🔄 How to Disable: Delete the corresponding .zip file from the datapacks folder and run the /reload command.

FAQ

Q: Why didn't I get a chest when I took damage?

A: Please ensure you see the success message after running /reload. Also, check that the datapack file structure is correct (pack.mcmeta should be directly in the .zip root directory, not nested inside another folder).

Q: Will the chest names display broken characters or raw JSON text?

A: No, the chest names have been fixed to display normally (e.g., "Shipwreck Treasure Chest") without color codes or extra symbols.

Q: Can I use this with other datapacks simultaneously?

A: Yes, this datapack does not modify vanilla loot tables; it only distributes extra chests. It is compatible with most other datapacks.
